headline: Operating profit and per-share earnings both improve
summary_short: Operating profit was about KRW 240.3B (+15.5% y/y per one source) and EPS was KRW 358, up 26.1% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 358 rose 867.6% q/q from a small base and 26.1% y/y. News reports put consolidated operating profit near KRW 240.3B; sources disagree on the y/y rate (7% vs 15.5%) and on revenue. Kakao Pay operating profit was KRW 32.5B and Kakao Games posted an operating loss. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Sources conflict on revenue (KRW 2.87T vs 2.09T) and operating profit growth (7% vs 15.5%); revenue is omitted. EPS is Yahoo data.
